name: instrument_types_after_at_number
notes: D9: fires at `@N ` exactly. Whole INSTRUMENT_TYPES table, kind TypeParameter, is_incomplete so the editor re-queries; `fm`/`pcm` carry TriggerSuggest (INSTRUMENT_TYPES_TRIGGER_SUGGEST) so the file picker opens right after acceptance; `2op` is the only snippet insert (D18).

items.label: pcm
items.documentation_contains: PCM samples are defined as instruments.

items.label: fm
items.documentation_contains: FM instruments are defined with ALG

name: instrument_types_keep_firing_while_typing
notes: D9 [RS]: the predicate stays satisfied while the typed text is a prefix of a known keyword (`f`), so the provider re-fires with the same 4 items and a range covering the typed word; is_incomplete lets the editor swap to the FM picker once `fm` is complete. Server-side filtering is NOT applied — the editor filters on filter_text.

name: rate_offset_fires_after_three_tokens
notes: D8: predicate = prefix ends with a space AND tokens (quote-aware) >= 3 AND `@<num>` `pcm` `"…"`. Items come strictly from the shared RATE_OFFSET table (label = table label, insert = table snippet), kind Property.

items.label: rate=<num>
items.documentation_contains: Override the sample rate of a PCM instrument.

items.label: offset=<num>
items.documentation_contains: Adjust the start position of a PCM instrument

name: rate_offset_refires_with_four_tokens
notes: D8: TS uses `tokens >= 3`, so a second modifier is still offered after `rate=8000 ` (native's `tokens == 3` would stop here).

name: fm_keyword_word_boundary_at_fmx
notes: ADJUDICATED: the FM predicate is `@<digits>` + required whitespace (megamml side) + `fm` + word boundary (native side) — the strict composite. `@1 fmx` matches no provider and hits the `@`-prefix bail: exclusive empty. megamml previously opened the picker here (behavior-change ledger).
